question: From what highest form down to what lowest form do these powers unfold?
premises: Brahma is seated on the lotus of awakening of a portion of his own power.
The powers unfold beginning from the auspicious Śiva form.
They extend down to the form of Brahma.
inference: The powers of consciousness unfold in a graded descent from the supreme Śiva form to the Brahma form.
plain_english: This Brahma is seated on the lotus of awakening of a portion of his own power; these powers unfold beginning from the auspicious Śiva form and extending finally to the form of Brahma.
